verdict.rationale: Runpod documents official SDKs for building against the platform. These include a Serverless SDK for Python, JavaScript and Go, and an official `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package for Public Endpoints. However, the evidenced SDKs are scoped to Serverless endpoints and Public Endpoints, and the pack mentions each only in one line. missing for 10: evidence of an official SDK covering Pods/clusters/volumes management, in-depth SDK reference docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install and configure the Serverless SDK for Python, JavaScript, or Go to interact with Serverless endpoints programmatically.
The `@runpod/ai-sdk-provider` package integrates Runpod Public Endpoints with the [Vercel AI SDK](https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/introduction).
Authenticate with Runpod and save your API key for all Flash operations, including CLI commands and standalone `@Endpoint` functions.
